mapper.insert: INSERT INTO comments ( "content", like_count, p_id, u_id, parent_c_id, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{content}, 0, #{pId}, #{uId}, #{parentCId}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, NULL )
mapper.select: SELECT c.c_id, c."content", c.like_count, c.p_id AS "pId", c.u_id AS "uId", c.parent_c_id, c.created_at, p.view_count, g.game_alias FROM comments c JOIN post p ON c.p_id = p.p_id JOIN game_list g ON p.game_id = g.game_id WHERE c.u_id = #{value} ORDER BY c.created_at DESC
SELECT c_id, "content", parent_c_id AS parentCId FROM comments WHERE c_id = #{cId}

SELECT c.c_id AS cid, c.content, c.like_count AS likeCount, c.p_id AS pid, c.u_id AS uid, c.parent_c_id AS parentCId, c.created_at AS createdAt, c.updated_at AS updatedAt, u.nickname AS nickname FROM comments c JOIN user_info u ON c.u_id = u.u_id WHERE c.p_id = #{pId} ORDER BY COALESCE(c.parent_c_id, c.c_id) ASC, c.created_at ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO like_history (u_id, p_id, c_id) VALUES (#{uId}, NULL, #{cId})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM like_history WHERE u_id = #{uId} AND c_id = #{cId}
